Under the direction of the Senior Director of Communications and working closely with the Director of Internal Communications, the Communications Coordinator plays an important role in supporting enterprise-wide communications initiatives across internal and executive communications, with additional support provided to media relations and reputation and incident management functions.
Coordinate and prioritize requests for internal communications support
Format and distribute employee communications across multiple internal channels
Manage email distribution calendars and maintain intranet content
Support the development and execution of internal communications strategies and campaigns
Facilitate efficient departmental workflows
Produce reports that measure the impact of internal and external communications
Use communication data and insights to support strategic and tactical decision-making
Collaborate with team members who are strategists, writers, editors and subject-matter experts in internal and executive communication, media relations and issues management
Interact with employees across multiple executive levels throughout the enterprise
Handle sensitive information and interactions with tact, discretion and emotional intelligence
This position is fully on-site in our Communications Office.
Exceptional attention to detail
Proficiency with content management systems, such as WordPress; email distribution platforms, such as ContactMonkey; media monitoring tools, such as Muck Rack; and project management tools
This is a full-time in-office position (in the Communications office)

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Strong organizational as well as interpersonal, written, verbal communications skills
